habitat: River backwaters, dams and lagoons. It roosts by day in trees or waterside vegetation and hunts at night. Nomadic when not breeding.
summary: A night heron with a black cap and back, contrasting with white and grey wings and underparts. The nape plumes may be absent. The immature has orange eyes and white spots on the tips of the upperpart feathers. The flight call is a high, slightly rasping wok.

similar.note: Black-crowned Night Heron also has a black crown and red eyes, but it is stockier, with a grey back rather than the white-and-grey wing contrast Newman gives for White-backed Night Heron.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^8=256 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 128–512.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

head.pattern: Black cap. Nape plumes may be absent.

wings.pattern: Wings white and grey, contrasting with the black back.

upperparts.pattern: White spots at the tips of the upperpart feathers.

viewNotes.note: Black cap and back against white and grey wings. A day roost in cover.
Black back contrasting with paler wings. The immature has white spots on the upperpart tips.
White and grey wings above the black back.
White underparts. A separate underwing colour was not named.

calls.description: A high-pitched, slightly rasping wok, often from a bird flying overhead at night. The texts do not separate the sexes. Grade A from Wassadou, Senegal. The filename says the file was edited by the recordist. It was not edited again here.

research.note: Status is resident and all twelve months are listed. Newman calls it a common resident and visitor, and nomadic when not breeding. The photograph shows a rufous neck that Newman did not name, so that colour was not stored. Chick down is not described. The call is grade A from Senegal and the file name says it was already edited.
